Whitney — thanks for sending these over and for the clarity on the DBA. Quick heads-up: when I ran the W-9 against our vendor tax validation tool, the EIN on the PDF (ending 8321) doesn't match the name mapping returned by the IRS crosscheck (the IRS lookup expects the EIN ending 8328 for "NovaData, Inc.").

To move the PO to active we need one of the following:
- a corrected W-9 with the EIN that matches IRS records, or
- an official bank letter or IRS CP575 showing the EIN assignment, or
- a notarized statement explaining the discrepancy plus an accounting-led confirmation.

I've copied Priyom (procurement) and Evelyn (Finance manager) to align on the minimum acceptable evidence so we don't hold the PO longer than necessary.

If you can send an EIN verification letter, that will probably be fastest.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
